claims.claim: Knossos/Samothrace sealings form a homogeneous transitional subgroup with rounded/full-bodied signs closer to Cretan Hieroglyphic.
On early seals often thin/elongated; on transitional sealings squatter and presented by Decorte as intermediate toward CH042/CH019.
Version of AS001/CH042 described as indistinguishable from later Cretan Hieroglyphic counterparts.
formula-bearing comparandum with AS001/CH042 form indistinguishable from later CH counterparts

guardrail: These are Decorte's diachronic/palaeographic interpretations, not project-established evolutionary descent.
